title: PAR-134 DetailViewStyle and SectionViewStyle DWG CMC retention with scalar-only DXF projection guard
mode: generated AC1024/AC1032 DWG object-vector and focused ASCII/Binary DXF fast slice
scope: Retain generic DWG CMC method, flags, reserved index, RGB, and optional color/book names for each DetailViewStyle and SectionViewStyle color slot
Preserve metadata through copy, assignment, reset, and parse lifecycle
Refuse lossy typed DXF projection for CMC states not representable by the existing scalar-only class output

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: The generated parser vectors exercise the generic R2004+ CMC envelope: reserved index, packed method/value, flags, and optional color/book strings. They do not establish class-specific ViewStyle color payload semantics beyond those common fields.

autodeskDxfSchema.finding: The reviewed Autodesk API material identifies DetailViewStyle and SectionViewStyle color properties but did not establish class-specific DXF truecolor, color-name, or book-name groups. The existing typed adapter projection is therefore kept scalar-only and richer states fail closed.

localCode.finding: The two DWG parsers normalized CMC color values but discarded method, reserved index, flags, and separate optional strings. The typed DXF overlays serialized scalar fields without a source-metadata loss check.

productionSummary: Append six DetailViewStyle and seven SectionViewStyle CMC metadata slots and preserve them through reset, copy, assignment, and R2004+ bounded parsing.
Clear stale DWG-only metadata when a DXF scalar color group is parsed.
Preflight all style colors before DXF output; allow only faithful scalar ByLayer, ByBlock, and ACI projections and reject richer, inconsistent, or unsupported CMC state atomically.

generatedControls.wireAndParser: Runtime-generated in-memory AC1024 and AC1032 object frames exercise C0-C3, named RGB, color/book strings, parser field alignment, and retention across both view-style color-slot sets.
generatedControls.lifecycle: Copy construction, assignment, and reset preserve or clear every retained metadata slot as expected.
generatedControls.dxfProjection: ASCII and Binary controls reject richer CMC metadata before modifying a sentinel destination; scalar-faithful ByLayer, ByBlock, and ACI fields remain accepted and read back.

validation.strictBuild: cmake --build build-gcc --target dxfrw dwg2dxf libdxfrw_dwg2dxf_adapter_tests libdxfrw_dwg_object_vectors_tests -j4
focusedCommands: git diff --check -- CMakeLists.txt src/drw_objects.h src/drw_objects.cpp dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp tests/dwg_object_vectors_tests.cpp tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp

evidenceLimits: Generated vectors establish local generic CMC parse/lifecycle behavior only; no independent DWG producer or native application was used.
No class-specific DXF truecolor/name/book mapping is claimed; richer typed projection remains fail-closed.
Appended public fields increase DRW_DetailViewStyle and DRW_SectionViewStyle sizes; downstream consumers must rebuild.
No persistent fixture, full suite, platform qualification, or support promotion was used.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
The shared worktree is broadly dirty; this slice is uncommitted and unstaged.
